title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£30,000-40,000

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Finance/Accounts Assistant - Credit Control, Sales Ledger & Purchase Ledger

Credit Control
- Accurately allocate customer receipts and investigate unallocated cash.
- Proactively chase overdue debt by telephone, email and written correspondence.
- Build and maintain effective customer relationships to encourage prompt payment.
- Issue customer statements and payment reminders.
- Monitor aged debt and produce regular reports for management.
- Attend and contribute to debtor review meetings.
- Investigate disputed invoices and work collaboratively with operational teams to achieve timely resolution.

- Process purchase invoices and credit notes accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Ensure invoices are appropriately authorised and correctly coded.
- Reconcile supplier statements and investigate any discrepancies.
- Manage supplier queries and resolve issues promptly.
- Prepare payment runs, including BACS and cheque payments where required.
- Maintain accurate supplier records and agreed payment terms.
- Assist with month-end procedures and financial reporting.

General Finance Duties
- Complete bank and cash book reconciliations.
- Process intercompany transactions and recharges as required.
- Maintain accurate electronic and manual filing systems.
- Support the Finance Management team with ad hoc financial administration and reporting.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures and financial controls.
- Maintain the confidentiality of financial and commercial information.
- Ensure Health & Safety policies are implemented consistently across the Group.
- Present the company and associated businesses in a professional manner at all times.
- Undertake any other reasonable duties commensurate with the role and the needs of the business.

Person Specification:
- Strong understanding of finance administration processes.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good numerical and analytical skills.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- Ability to prioritise workload and consistently meet deadlines.
- Competent using Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Experience:
- Previous experience in Credit Control, Sales Ledger and Purchase Ledger.
- Using accounting or ERP systems.
- Working within a multi-company environment.
- Using Dimensions or similar finance software.
- Experience producing management information and KPI reports.
- Knowledge of CIS and Retentions.

- Monday - Friday

Work Location:
- In Person

title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Supply Chain Coordinator
Location: Corby, Northamptonshire
Contract: Temporary (opportunity to extend to permanent)
Hours: Full Time, 37.5 hours per week
Salary: £30,000 - £32,000
Start Date: Immediately

The Procurement and Supply Chain Division at SF Recruitment are currently recruiting for a really exciting business located in Corby who are passionate about making a difference and producing high quality services and products for their customers. Due to business demand and 2026/2027 company predictions, they require an experienced Supply Chain Coordinator to join their team.

The Supply Chain Coordinator job is starting on an ongoing temporary basis, however, for the right person, there is the opportunity of this extending to a permanent contract. What is essential is that you are immediately available to interview and start in a new job.

As a Supply Chain Coordinator, you will be responsible for:
- Raising and processing customer order requests.
- Coordinating timely deliveries with hauliers across the UK and Internationally.
- Handling inbound telephone and email enquiries regarding order status', delayed deliveries and damaged stock.
- Maintaining an accurately updated database with order forms, delivery notes, invoices and product details.
- Updating accurate customer, haulier and supplier records.
- Reporting Out of stocks to manager and other stakeholders.
- Maintaining consistent communication with customers on order confirmation, shipment status and any delay/arrival expectations of goods.
- Liaising directly between customer service, sales support and production teams to ensure a smooth operational process.

The successful candidate will have previous experience as above, or come from a scheduling/coordinating background within a fast paced environment.

Key skills that are essential:
- Ability to act and make decisions under pressure.
- Confident handling high volume personalized customer orders.
- Strong attention to detail and level of accuracy.
- Ability to communicate effectively across multiple internal departments and externally with UK and international suppliers/hauliers.
- Excellent communication both verbal and written in English - any additional languages would be advantageous.

4 days office based, 1 day working from home.
Monday - Friday 8:30am - 17:00pm.

To progress an application forward, please click 'Apply Now' with a copy of your updated CV.

With this being a temporary to permanent position you will either be immediately available or have no more than a 2 weeks notice period.

title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: We are a busy 11,000 patient GP practice in Northamptonshire looking for an Receptionist/Administrator for hours to be arranged to join our friendly team. Opening hours 8.00am - 6.30pm Monday to Friday. We would be looking for someone who can provide flexible cover during opening times. This is a fast-paced and varied role that requires excellent communication skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure. You will manage a range of administrative and patient-facing tasks, ensuring the smooth running of our daily clinics. Greeting patients and visitors both in person and over the telephone. Booking, cancelling, and rescheduling appointments via the SystmOne clinical system. Processing repeat prescription requests and handling diverse patient enquiries. Managing incoming and outgoing post, clinical coding tasks, and scanning documentation. Assist with ad-hoc administrative tasks as needed. Liaising with GPs, nurses, and external healthcare providers (e.g., secondary care and pharmacies). Maintaining patient confidentiality and data protection (GDPR) at all times. You will play a vital role in ensuring the efficient day-to-day operations of the practice. Your responsibilities will include welcoming patients, managing appointment scheduling, handling incoming calls, and supporting the administrative team with various clerical tasks. The ideal candidate will be organised, detail-oriented, and skilled in providing excellent customer service to patients and visitors. Your contribution will help create a welcoming atmosphere that enhances patient experience, while upholding confidentiality and adhering to healthcare regulations and practice policies.

title: Receptionist
description: Receptionist is responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and providing support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties may include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, processing of personal information and assisting patients as required. To act as a central point of contact for patients, the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with the multidisciplinary team member and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. The core responsibilities of the receptionist are as follows. On occasion, there may be a requirement to carry out tasks not listed below, that are within the reasonable scope of the role. Maintain and monitor practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments Answer incoming phone calls, dealing with the callers request appropriately Signpost patients to the correct service Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as requested Input data as necessary onto patients healthcare records Direct requests for information to relevant team members i.e., SAR, DVLA forms, insurance/solicitors letters Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner Carry out system searches as requested Support all clinical staff with general tasks as required Photocopy documentation as required Maintain a clean, tidy and effective working area Monitor and maintain the reception area and notice boards In addition to the core responsibilities, the Receptionist may be requested to; 1. Action incoming emails and correspondence as necessary 2. Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the rota 3. Partake in audit as directed by the audit lead 4. Support admin team, providing cover during absences 5. Scan patient related documents and attach scanned documents to patients healthcare record
